title: Easily Install and Load the healthyverse
text: healthyR - Tools analyzing common data problems healthcare administrative data. Includes functions calculating length stay, readmission rates, healthcare-specific metrics. healthyR.data - Provides simulated healthcare datasets testing learning. Perfect educational purposes developing proof--concept analyses.

title: Easily Install and Load the healthyverse
text: healthyR.ts - Comprehensive time-series analysis forecasting functions optimized healthcare data patterns. Includes tools seasonal decomposition, trend analysis, automated forecasting.

title: Easily Install and Load the healthyverse
text: healthyR.ai - AI machine learning utilities specifically designed healthcare applications. Features automated model building, evaluation, prediction workflows. tidyAML - Automated machine learning (AutoML) framework built tidymodels. Streamlines process training, tuning, comparing multiple models simultaneously.

title: Easily Install and Load the healthyverse
text: TidyDensity - Generate visualize probability distributions tidy format. Makes easy work , compare, plot various statistical distributions. RandomWalker - Simulate analyze random walk processes. Useful modeling stochastic processes understanding random behavior systems.
